title: Chapter 294: True Strength
content:
Chapter 294: True Strength

boom!

A moment later, two huge thunder tribulations fell straight towards Xiao Luo and Qin Feng from the tumultuous clouds.

Its power is actually many times stronger than the previous young man's imperial tribulation.

"ah!!!"

Soon, two familiar screams sounded from both directions.

The shrill sound has been echoing since ancient times, and it sounds particularly creepy.

It is not a very common thing that two emperor tribulations appear at the same time.

On a clearing lot far away.

Lu Xuedan sat on the ground and watched the Emperor Jie keep knocking down expressionlessly, his eyes as calm as water.

Anyway, it's not her that she has overcome the disaster.

Of course, Lu Xue naturally could not just watch the two of them being ravaged by the Emperor's Tribulation, but carefully observe the power of the Emperor's Tribulation.

In terms of scale, Xiao Luo and his two emperor tribulation were definitely several times or even dozens of times that of the young man just now.

In terms of power, there is no need to say much.

The stronger the talent, the more difficult the emperor's disaster will increase.

The two of them are already very talented, and with the blessing of their father, they must have become the top star in the fairy world.

As time goes by, the clouds of disasters in the void grow stronger and stronger.

The terrifying thunder tribulation that descends from it is also becoming more and more fierce.

The screams of the two had already been submerged in the rolling thunder tribulation and could not be heard.

Looking at this scene, Lu Xue gradually frowned.

Is the thunder tribulation brought by that ancient shield really the same as the normal thunder tribulation?

It’s a pity that Lu Xue has never seen a normal imperial disaster, otherwise she would have been able to see something.

After breathing deeply, Lu Xue shook her head slightly.

I can only take one step first.

It’s just a little bit smoother for the past three years, and now I’m actually teased by a spirit of weapon.

As for whether Xiao Luo and Qin Feng can survive the Emperor's Tribulation, Lu Xue is not worried at all. Although it may be too hasty, the two of them should not be able to even overcome the Emperor's Tribulation.

Sure enough, with the last deafening roar, sounded.

The entire outer periphery of the ancient battlefield trembled.

boom!

Two huge shock waves continued to spread from two different directions toward the surroundings, stirring up dust in the sky.

In an instant, Lu Xue's vision became hazy.

The Emperor's Tribulation is over.

However, at this moment, the change emerged again!

Three strange figures rushed towards Xiao Luo and the others at a terrifying speed.

The intention was obviously to kill the two of them when they had just passed the imperial tribulation and were weak.

Seeing this scene, how could Lu Xue sit still?

"court death!"

"Xiaoqing, go!"

In an instant, Lu Xue and Ao Qing flashed and rushed over.

At this moment, Lu Xue was shocked and angry.

She never expected that when her identities with Ao Qing were exposed, there would be someone who dared to stand up and be enemies with them at this time.

bite!

The sound of metal collision sounded.

Ao Qing used his thick body to block two attacks.

Two blades collided with Ao Qing Dragon Scale, and sparks flew everywhere for a moment.

I have to say that Ao Qing's physical body is really terrifying. Before he could buy into the Immortal Emperor Realm, his physical body is already as hard as an ordinary imperial weapon.

On the other hand, Lu Xue also rushed to Xiao Luo.

At this time, a sharp arrow feather was shooting rapidly towards Xiao Luomei's heart, with murderous intent surging.

"Sister Xue, be careful!"

Xiao Luo exclaimed.

The strength of the arrow feather in front of you cannot be underestimated!

In response to this, Lu Xue snorted coldly, and the Xuanyuan Sword in her hand suddenly buzzed.

The sound of the sword sounded.

A broken arrow feather suddenly landed at Lu Xue's feet.

At this time, Lu Xue also saw the enemy clearly.

A woman holding a big red and golden eagle bow in her hand and wearing a short skirt, her long hair was tied to the back of her head, looking very cool.

"Who are you?"

Looking at the woman with bow and arrow in the distance, Lu Xue asked coldly.

However, in the face of Lu Xue's questioning, the woman in the distance did not say a word.

In response to Lu Xue, a carving man pulled the arrow feathers.

call out!

This arrow feather was stronger than the previous one, and the space began to tremble slightly wherever it passed.

You know, this is an ancient battlefield. After endless years of influence, the space here has long been so stable that it is unimaginable.

Even ordinary immortal emperor realm powerhouses who can create the world cannot even achieve the most basic space for opening up after entering here.

At this moment, the woman in front of her bow and arrow was able to influence the space here with casual arrow feathers.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue's expression slightly condensed.

"Immortal Emperor Realm."

Yes, the woman in front of her is a powerful Immortal Emperor realm.

Although it is only the early stage.

But on the periphery of this ancient battlefield, it is definitely an invincible existence.

So on the other side, the two people Ao Qing faced were also powerful people in the Immortal Emperor realm.

Thinking of this, Lu Xue suddenly realized it.

There is no wonder that the three powerful people in the Immortal Emperor Realm dare to attack them.

However, since you dare to expose your murderous intention to them, then be prepared to be killed by her.

He threw Xiao Luo a recovery pill, and Lu Xue immediately stepped forward.

At the same time, a stream of cold and bone-bone-broken coldness slowly overflowed from Lu Xue's body.

The entire venue entered the Ice Age in an instant.

Huh ~

Lu Xue breathed slightly, and her expression suddenly became extremely sharp.

"It seems that I should be serious, too."

The tiger doesn't show off her power, and she really thinks she is a cat.

Let you rustic guys see what a real genius is.

bite!

I saw Lu Xue inserted the Xuanyuan Sword in her hand to the ground beside her.

Seeing this scene, the woman with bow and arrow in the distance frowned slightly.

What's the meaning?

Look down on her?

At this time, Arrow Feather had already arrived in front of Lu Xue.

Lu Xue suddenly shook her whole body.

An unimaginable force of blood gushed out from Lu Xue's body.

The hot blood kept flowing from Lu Xue's body.

But what overflows outside the body is the ultimate coldness.

In just an instant, the arrow feather that was about to shoot Lu Xue was directly frozen in mid-air and then slowly landed on the ground.

There was a click.

The arrow feathers broke into ice slag.

However, it was not over yet. A lifelike ice phoenix figure slowly rose above Lu Xue's head and circled above Lu Xue's head.

The ice phoenix roared to the sky.

The chill, like a thousand years of black iron, suddenly rushed towards all directions.

"Ice Domain, get up!"

boom!

Suddenly, Lu Xue was like a bomb, and the violent ice aura continued to explode from her body.

Within a radius of thousands of miles, everything was completely frozen, as if it was dead silent.

The woman in the distance had long lost the peace she had when facing Lu Xue at this time.

Lu Xuecai is the Immortal Lord Realm!

How could it be so strong? This is unreasonable.

In fact, it is already unreasonable for Lu Xue to be in the fairy world.

No longer hesitated, the woman with bow and arrow turned around and ran away.

As a long-range attack, her escape speed is obviously also excellent.

In just a moment, his back was almost gone.

Seeing the woman with bow and arrow turning around and running away, Lu Xue smiled disdainfully.

I just want to run away now, it's too late.

In the ice domain created by Lu Xue, Lu Xue is the only king!
